sections.Description:
Stern’s James Bond 007 cornerstone pinball machine will highlight film footage and iconic music from the films that built the 007 legend.

Players are immersed into the world of espionage in this action-packed pinball experience, tackling assignments, teaming up with key allies, and stopping SPECTRE’s villainous schemes.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Roof Ejection: Gather gadgets from Q Branch as pinballs get ejected through the roof of a custom sculpted Aston Martin DB5.
- Bird One Rocket: Break through the Osato Chemicals drop targets to battle SPECTRE at the Bird One rocket base.
- Rocket Pack Escape: Escape using Rocket Pack by shooting the Left Orbit and watch the ball travel across the playfield.
sections.Editions:
